description: Parkings de compétence métropolitaine is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Liste, localisation et capacité des parkings barriérés concédés qui appartiennent à la métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Cette donnée ne contient pas les parkings privés. La métropole a concédé la gestion de ces parkings à des exploitants (en DSP) ou des communes. Les parkings s'étendent sur tout le territoire de la métropole. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Mobilité, transport, parking, déplacements. The portal shows 43 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
